content: make a jukebox that plays music when you click it

The jukebox looks right in the viewport: it stands on the grass with no gap, and it reads as a real music player — arched top, glowing front panel with a music note, speaker grille below. Click it or press the on-screen "Play Music" button to start the looping tune; press again to stop.

behaviours[0].verb must be one of swing, slide, spin, bob, fade, light, sound, emit, bounce (add_behaviour {model} with no behaviours lists what each takes). Nothing was written.
behaviours[0]: sound does not take "on" (it takes: id, target, with, trigger, mode, hold, delay, ease, sound, soundId, volume, pitch, variance, range, fade, loop). Nothing was written.

verbs.swing: turn the target (and `with` parts) about a hinge line and back; hinge = {pivot: a point on the target's box as -1..1 of each half-size, axis: its own x|y|z}. takes: angle -360..360 (not 0) =90; seconds 0.05..30 =0.6
verbs.slide: move the target (and `with`) by an offset and back. takes: offset [x,y,z] ±1000 (not all 0); space local|world =local; seconds 0.05..30 =0.6
verbs.spin: turn without end about an axis through a pivot (hinge = {pivot?, axis?}, default centre about y). takes: speed -1440..1440 (not 0) =90
verbs.bob: rise and fall about rest, as a sine or as hops. takes: axis x|y|z =y; amount 0.02..100 =1; period 0.2..60 =2; shape sine|hop =sine
verbs.fade: go to a transparency (not solid once gone) and back. takes: to 0..1 =1; seconds 0.05..30 =0.4; collide =true
verbs.light: switch the lights under the target (or make one), optionally glow Neon. takes: color [x,y,z] 01 =[1,0.85,0.6]; brightness 0..20 =2; range 2..120 =16; seconds 0..5 =0.25; glow =false
verbs.sound: play a Sound from the target: `sound` = path of a Sound in the place (cloned) or `soundId` from find_sound; loop starts/stops with the trigger. takes: volume 0..4 =0.6; pitch 0.1..4 =1; variance 0..0.5 =0.04; range 4..1000 =60; fade 0..5 =0.3; loop =false
verbs.emit: burst the particle emitters under the target, or sustain true to switch them on and off. takes: count 1..500 =20; sustain =false
verbs.bounce: launch whoever touches the target; always listens for touch. takes: power 10..400 =80; direction [x,y,z] ±1 (not all 0) =[0,1,0]; cooldown 0.1..10 =0.6

detail.every: id (edit/remove later; the same id replaces); target (a part or sub-model, default the whole model); with [paths that move together]; trigger {on: click|prompt|touch|near|auto, at: the part that carries the click/prompt, text, reach studs, cooldown s} or just the name (default click; spin, bob auto; bounce touch); mode toggle|pulse|hold|once (click toggles, touch pulses, near holds); hold s; delay s; ease Linear|Sine|Quad|Back|Bounce|Elastic. auto starts on its own (swing, slide, fade then go back and forth), not for a one-shot sound or burst.
detail.paths: relative to the model (Cover, Group.Cover) or full; the 2nd of a repeated name is Name#2
detail.runs: when the game runs, not in Edit. Moving parts are anchored; a joint between a moving part and one that stays is switched off.
